sourceLicense.notice: Static mechanics/balance facts extracted from AGPL-marked source. No separate permissive data license or Pokémon asset rights are asserted.
sourceLicense.method: Independent TypeScript AST syntax reader; upstream constructors, callbacks, factories, methods, conditions and RNG are not executed.

fieldSemantics.ids: All enum IDs are original upstream IDs, not PokeAPI IDs. Enum maps are name→source value.
fieldSemantics.biomeLinks: Raw ID or [ID,denominator] declarations. linkRules probability is candidate inclusion, not final route selection probability.
fieldSemantics.constructors: __class/args and sourceCalls describe syntax only. Constructor defaults, inherited initFor* behavior and method bodies are not applied.
fieldSemantics.callbacks: Function bodies are __unparsedFunction; runtime references/calls/conditions and increment counters have source locations in omissions.
fieldSemantics.undefined: {__undefined:true} preserves an explicit undefined argument/default placeholder instead of replacing it with null.
fieldSemantics.fixedGroups: eliteFourChampionGroups transposes the ten aligned getRandomTrainerFunc pool options; nested choices remain alternatives. RNG and seeded region selection are not run.
fieldSemantics.trainerConfigs: TrainerType table key identifies the trainer even when its constructor counter argument is unresolved. sourceCalls preserve static call order and arguments only.
fieldSemantics.partyStrength: The source enum is named PartyMemberStrength; no fabricated TrainerPartyStrength enum was introduced.

wrappers.handling: Only literal argument data is read; Object.freeze is not invoked.
Only the declared target is read; handler/default behavior is not applied.
